# RoutePlan validator fixtures

These fixtures are generated by `routing-v2/scripts/build_route_plan_fixtures.py` from
generic structures in `routing-v2/tests/route_plan_fixture_factory.py`.

The `case_refs` fields point to frozen oracle/corpus IDs solely to show provenance.
No production validator rule contains a specimen name, amount or legal conclusion.
Every `*.fail.json` file has a matching clean scenario and changes only the field needed
to expose its named defect.
